newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Wednesday easier against the U.S. dollar and the rand but was quoted firmer on sterling and the mark after a lacklustre interbank session, dealers said.
"Nothing much happened to write home about today. Trade was very thin and the dollar was still tracking the same ranges," commented one dealer.
"But tomorrow we have a few loan repayments coming up and that could move the market...but only very marginally," he added.
The local unit finished the day at 10.2300/2600 from 10.2200/2600 against the U.S. currency and slipped to 2.2820/2910 versus South Africa's rand from 2.2740/2850 overnight.
Against sterling, however, it was quoted firmer at 15.8940/9490 compared to 15.8980/9690 and edged up to 6.7770/8000 from 6.7850/8180 against the mark.
